messages:
ellie.ng: quick async standup — security team (IAM / KMS / audits)

ellie.ng: What I did: finished review of the KMS key rotation playbook, pushed edits to the runbook PR (#482). Also triaged last week's vuln scan results and flagged two medium findings for remediation.
ellie.ng: Blockers: waiting on infrastructure access for the dev cluster to validate key rotation scripts (asking infra for a short-lived role).
ellie.ng: Today: will follow up on PR #482, and start a small test of the rotation in staging if infra gives access. pinging @samir.khan for the role request.

samir.khan: What I did: created the short-lived role for key ops, IAM policy attached, tested with a service account. Left notes in the infra repo under /ops/kms.
samir.khan: Blockers: none for the role, but noticed one service account still had overly broad iam:PassRole perms — I queued a PR to restrict it (PR #489).
samir.khan: Today: merging PR #489 after a quick review, then hand off creds to @ellie.ng for rotation test. Also will run a small smoke test of the staging rotation.

jordan.w: What I did: triaged vuln scan false positives, removed noise rules, and re-ran the scanner with updated baseline. Also started an eval of dependency upgrades for the auth service.
jordan.w: Blockers: waiting on decision from product about maintaining legacy token endpoints — we need to lock down scopes if we keep them.
jordan.w: Today: will open an RFC for token deprecation window and scope tightening, and will review PR #489 for the PassRole fix.

maria.p: What I did: compliance checklist update — mapped the new KMS rotation schedule to our SOC2 timeline and updated evidence steps.
maria.p: Blockers: need confirmation on rotation cadence from ops (daily vs. weekly rotate keys for staging). Asked @samir.khan for recommended cadence.
maria.p: Today: will add the rotation evidence template to the compliance drive and sync with Trust & Safety tomorrow.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: a new IAM role creation was completed for team "security-ops" (role: security-ops-kms-test). Build: #deploy-2026-03-12-08. Logs: https://ci.internal/deploys/2026-03-12-08

ellie.ng: quick notes / asks:
- @samir.khan: can you post the exact sts assume-role command you validated? I'll use it in the runbook.
- @jordan.w @maria.p: if we decide weekly rotation for staging, we should still rotate test keys immediately after each test to avoid reuse.
- can reviewers please look at PR #482 and #489 today? small reviews would unblock the test.

samir.khan: sts command (copied from my test):
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/security-ops-kms-test --role-session-name kms-rot-test
```
samir.khan: also added a note in the infra repo about automating the post-test key purge.

jordan.w: Reviewing #489 now, aim to finish before lunch. :thumbsup:

maria.p: I'll add the compliance note about purging after tests into the checklist.

ellie.ng: thanks — if everyone can ack once reviews are done, I'll kick off rotation in staging and paste results here. If we hit any access errors I'll escalate to infra on-call.

samir.khan: ack
jordan.w: ack
maria.p: ack

ellie.ng: thanks all — updating runbook and will post results in this thread once rotation completes.
